title: Coral and the Summer
author: Juniper Villalobos
blurb: Casper Pemberton, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
